The ICE models were phased out around 2024, replaced by the electric 500e. The provided trim string 'Competizione / Scorpione / Nuvolari S' combines three distinct variants that have different power outputs (180hp, 145hp, and 165hp respectively) and equipment levels. Therefore, a split is required.
